title: shiyo'n ka tha ye bayaa'n haye taqi haaye haaye
body:
shiyo'n ka tha ye bayaa'n haaye taqi haaye haaye
haaye imame zamaa'n haaye taqi haaye haaye
shor madine me hai rote hai chote bade
haaye shahe inso jaa'n haaye taqi haaye haaye
<<DIVIDER>>
aapki thi kya qata zehr jo be dee'n diya
aye shahe kouno makaa'n haaye taqi haaye haaye
deke laee'n motasam aapko afsos sam
kardiya qaali jahaa'n haaye taqi haaye haaye
<<DIVIDER>>
shiyo'n ka hai koun ab hogaya kaisa ghazab kyu na ho giryakuna haaye taqi haaye haaye
sarware aali nasab samjha na wo be adab
aapko ahmad ki jaa'n haaye taqi haaye haaye
